title: Justifying faith object includes all revealed: promises, threats, precepts, dogmas
source_text: XXI. Quod spectat ad fidei justificantis objectum, sedulo notant & accurate docent Doctores Scholae Romanae ad illud pertinere quaecunque Verbo Dei Ecclesiae tradita atque revelata sunt, nempe non gratiae promissiones tantum, sed minas etiam, praecepta & dogmata, qualiacunque Deo revelare visum est, & Ecclesiae proponere. Nec solum docent fidem quae salvat atque justificat objecta illa omnia spectare & considerare, verum etiam id facere quatenus justificans atque salvifica est: adeo ut fides justificet, non simpliciter quatenus promissiones gratiae amplectitur, sed etiam quatenus dogmatis assentitur, & mysteria credit, minasque & praecepta eo quo par est obsequio & reverentia suscipit. Haec enim singula fides in justificationis negotio varie respicit ex ipsorum sententia.
pass_a_gloss: As for the object of justifying faith, the doctors of the Roman school carefully note and accurately teach that whatever has been handed down and revealed to the Church by the Word of God belongs to it, not grace promises only, but also threats, precepts, and dogmas, whatever God has seen fit to reveal and propose to the Church. They teach not only that saving and justifying faith looks at and considers all those objects, but that it does so insofar as it is justifying and saving: so that faith justifies not simply insofar as it embraces the promises of grace, but also insofar as it assents to dogmas, believes mysteries, and receives threats and precepts with due obedience and reverence. For faith variously regards each of these in the business of justification, according to their view.
pass_b_english: Roman doctors place in justifying faith object everything revealed to the Church in God Word: grace-promises, but also threats, precepts, and dogmas.
Faith saves and justifies not only by embracing grace-promises, but also by assenting to dogmas, believing mysteries, and receiving threats and precepts with fitting obedience and reverence.

lemmas.gloss: insofar as it is justifying and saving

choices.why: Rome widens object beyond promises alone.
rejected: promises of grace as sole object
